name: WAR-State
description: Raw deterministic audit pass for normal evidence matching. Use when you want fast, explainable checks without heavier judgment.

name: Light-State
description: Lenient pass that focuses on obvious unsupported claims and avoids over-penalizing weak wording.

name: Person-State
description: Person-like review style for motive, context, and wording intent. Best for CVs, profiles, and pitch material.

name: Strict WAR+AI-State
description: Strict combined mode for high-stakes reviews where every strong claim needs clear support.
